verdict.rationale: The docs clearly scope multimodal input. The grok-4.7 model card lists modalities as "text, image → text", and the image-understanding docs say "Some models allow images in the input". Documents can be attached to chat messages and searched via attachment_search. Audio is handled through dedicated speech-to-text models supporting 12 formats, plus image and video inputs for the generation and editing endpoints. Missing for 10: audio input goes to a separate transcription model rather than directly to the chat model; no detail on image input limits (formats, size); no independent or hands-on corroboration.
